notes.title: Steam Deck Verfied and 50% off
notes.content: [h2]Dotson on Deck[/h2][p]Detective Dotson plays has received Steam Deck Verified status from Steam![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273861/6111e329ec441dfb9fd6813857ce96ff42a41679.png"][/img][/p][p]The game looks and plays really well on the deck with larger text adjusted for the device.[/p][p]Controller support is improved and the controller now works in the phone booth.[/p][p]We've also added Korean and Russian language support.[/p][p]Additionally there are performance fixes in the game.[/p][p][/p][h2]An exciting summer[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273861/72da169315152a0846d9e93eb91cad15ec727668.png"][/img][/p][p]We've got a summer filled with events and a 50% sale to celebrate[/p][p]We are part of Debut Festival from August 7[/p][p]We will be celebrating the Indian Independence Day on August 15[/p][h2][/h2][h2]Amma is coming[/h2][p]Don't get too comfortable in summer, because Amma is coming![/p][p]Our chapter 2 free update is in the works and we are busy adding twists and turns you won't see coming.[/p][p]What's more Detective Dotson will be at Gamescom and Tokyo Games Show[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273861/98470907cbd4760398ae13e24aad5afa0282c60e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273861/9e88effb51727d411331c2ccb04dfc22d1bb4a26.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: May 7 update (4 languages, character bios and fixes)
notes.content:
We've added 4 new languages!
Traditional Chinese
German
Spanish
French

Added cute character intros in the main menu. Collect them all!
There's one more secret one that I can't put in this picture :)
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nzCcqYKm/dc-steam.png[/img]

Of course Parth had to blink while this picture was taken 🤦‍♀️

A bunch of fixes. Thank you all for reporting them!

We are now featuring full controller and Steam Deck support (will do a separate post on that)
